verdict_reason: AC1 (the customer is notified via email/push with the rep's custom message) is not met. Both channels can be unchecked and the share still commits with sendCustomerCommunication never firing; when it does fire, a succeeded:false / warnings[] response is silently swallowed by the UI. AC2 and AC3 pass and BL-SR-002 holds.
verdict_note_operator: Operator decision 2026-08-07: every failing finding is being carved out into its own STORY, not filed as a VCST-5332 defect. Under that framing VCST-5332 delivers its shipped scope (AC2 + AC3 + BL-SR-002) and the gaps are forward scope; the FAIL verdict reflects AC1 as originally written on this ticket.

steps.note: Deployment gate: 'Customer' scope present in List settings; theme 2.55.0-pr-2405.
Rep signs in, 10 served customers, 3 lists, scope badges render.
Dialog: 4-option scope dropdown, searchable customer combobox, Link+copy, Message (0/907), Email+Push checked by default.
Both channels unchecked -> Save stays enabled, no validation, share persists, sendCustomerCommunication never fires. Finding #5.
ChangeWishlist scope=Customer + sharedWithId; badge flips to 'Shared with customer'.
Reopen: customer persists but Message and the whole 'Send via' group are absent. Findings #4 + #6.
Single-select; picking B retains only B. A new inline warning discloses it pre-save. Finding #1, partially mitigated.
Superseded by S11 - the buyer account works; the earlier invalid_grant was a wrong password recorded in memory.
Banner renders, per-item Add to cart works; NO list-level actions and the Order summary card shows a subtotal with zero buttons. Finding #3.
Non-member org -> /403 Access denied. BL-SR-002 upheld.

Silent grant CONFIRMED (B2C-LIST-050): both channels off -> ChangeWishlist only, no sendCustomerCommunication, yet the recipient opens the list via the Link. The list is absent from the recipient's /account/lists and from their inbox - the link is the ONLY entry point, so a zero-channel share is unreachable in practice.

Finding #2 CONFIRMED with a genuine non-owner recipient (B2C-LIST-051): same user, same URL - 403 under Watermelon123 (org Y), renders under Purple Pink123 (org X). Access is gated on the ACTIVE org, not the membership set. The earlier inconclusive result was the list-owner bypass.

Per-channel routing honoured both ways (B2C-LIST-048/049). Push-only: succeeded:true, pushSent:true, emailSent:false, warnings[] empty, push received carrying the rep's typed message verbatim. Email-only: pushSent:false (unchecked channel correctly suppressed), emailSent:false warnings:[EmailSendFailed] - env SMTP gap, not a routing defect.

reopen_findings_reverification.2_multi_org_403: STILL-PRESENT - CONFIRMED as reported, owner-bypass confound eliminated
reopen_findings_reverification.3_no_bulk_actions: STILL-PRESENT (worse - the Order summary card renders a subtotal with no CTA at all)
reopen_findings_reverification.5_both_channels_unchecked: STILL-PRESENT (and the silent-grant half is now proven end to end)

root_cause_note: Findings #4/#5/#6 collapse into one dialog defect: the Message + 'Send via' block is bound to a pending-new-customer-selection state instead of to scope === 'Customer', and no validation requires >=1 channel. The message is never persisted on the wishlist (ChangeWishlist carries only listId/listName/description/scope/sharingKey/sharedWithId/cultureName) - it travels only in the fire-and-forget sendCustomerCommunication mutation.

new_findings.title: sendCustomerCommunication failures are silently swallowed by the UI
new_findings.note: Two of three sends this pass returned succeeded:false (EmailSendFailed, and earlier NoRecipients) and in every case the dialog closed as a clean success - no toast, no inline error. The response already carries succeeded / emailSent / pushSent / warnings[]; the frontend ignores all four. The rep is told the customer was notified when they demonstrably were not. Cheapest fix in the ticket.

new_findings.title: Customer picker lists indistinguishable duplicate org names
new_findings.note: The BARE variants ('Purple Pink' x2, 'Watermelon' x2) are genuinely distinct orgs with no id/code disambiguator; choosing wrong silently revokes the other. Partly seed-data driven, but the UI should disambiguate.

new_findings.title: The /403 page is a dead end for a legitimate recipient
new_findings.note: Offers only a 'Home page' link - no explanation that the list belongs to another organization, no org switcher. The correct org is one click away in the account menu, so a recoverable state is presented as terminal. The UX half of finding #2.

new_findings.title: EmailSendFailed on vcptcore-qa
new_findings.note: The email channel returns warnings:[EmailSendFailed] while push works on the same org - outbound SMTP is not configured on this env. Not a product defect, but it means the email half of AC1 cannot be proven here.

fixture_resolution.account: belovedushka@gmail.com / Password1! (SINGLE trailing '!'). The earlier invalid_grant was a wrong password recorded in memory (Password1!!), not a dead account. Verified via POST {BACK_URL}/connect/token + storeId=B2B-store -> 200, memberId 3bd3f19c-a54a-4b71-b664-753a77e1b612. Both memory files corrected 2026-08-07.
fixture_resolution.orgs: Member of the 123-SUFFIXED orgs: Purple Pink123 (e941220a-289d-46b3-a212-bd66f0b9f4c3, default active), Mercury123 (e4168e7c-dd16-40ef-a671-98a2d6c50ab9), Watermelon123 (cb7ed54a-9b3e-4235-b4d6-28be7e7fceb1), plus 3 orgs the rep cannot select.
fixture_resolution.duplicate_name_trap: The duplicate names in the customer picker are the BARE variants - genuinely distinct orgs. The 123-suffixed ones are unique. Identity proven by GUID: GetMe contact.organization.id == the sharedWithId the ChangeWishlist mutation sent. The bare 'Purple Pink' has no emailable member, which retro-explains the earlier NoRecipients warning as correct backend behaviour on an empty org, not a bug.

business_rules_verified: BL-SR-002 (PASS - S9 non-member denied, S11 scope enforced on the active org)
console_network: No JS exceptions, no Vue warnings, no unhandled rejections, no 5xx. All /graphql 200 with an empty errors[] - including sendCustomerCommunication, which signals failure IN-BAND via succeeded:false + warnings[], which is precisely why the UI misses it. Known env noise only: App Insights dc.services.visualstudio.com/v2/track 400s and catalog image 404s.

partially_grounded: B2C-LIST-048 - the channel-honoured half is {OBSERVED}; the emailSent:true half is tagged {SPEC}, unprovable while this env has no outbound SMTP
new_test_cases.channel_partition_note: The channel-selection set is covered as 4 equivalence partitions: both = B2C-LIST-040 (PASS), none = B2C-LIST-041 (FAIL, no validation) + B2C-LIST-050 (the silent-grant half), email-only = B2C-LIST-048, push-only = B2C-LIST-049.

coverage_gaps_acknowledged: Email DELIVERY (the email half of AC1) cannot be proven on vcptcore-qa - outbound SMTP is unconfigured (EmailSendFailed). Push delivery WAS proven end to end. B2C-LIST-048 carries the email assertion as {SPEC} pending an env with mail.
